name: Prime SEO
author: primeseo

sections.description:
Prime SEO is the modern SEO plugin built for the AI era. Beyond traditional SEO, it helps your content get discovered by AI search engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google SGE, and Claude. Clean interface, powerful optimization, and everything you need to rank higher — in both traditional and AI search.

Setup Wizard

Get started in minutes! Our interactive 4-step wizard guides you through:

  • Homepage SEO configuration
  • Feature toggles (Sitemap, Image SEO, External Links, 404 Monitor)
  • Robots.txt setup with best practices
  • Ready to go!

Easy Migration

Switching from another SEO plugin? No problem! Import your data with one click:

  • Yoast SEO — Titles, descriptions, focus keywords, canonical URLs, noindex/nofollow
  • Rank Math — All SEO data + redirects
  • All in One SEO — Full metadata migration
  • SEOPress — Complete data transfer

Your existing SEO work is preserved — no need to start from scratch!

Modern Dashboard

Beautiful, intuitive dashboard with real-time statistics:

  • Published Posts & Pages count
  • Active Redirects counter
  • 404 Errors monitor
  • Homepage SEO with live Google Preview
  • Quick Links to all features

Advanced SEO Metabox

Optimize every post and page with our powerful metabox:

  • Tabbed Interface — General, Advanced, Analysis tabs
  • Circular SEO Score — Visual 0-100 score indicator
  • Multiple Focus Keywords — Analyze unlimited keywords per post
  • Live Google Preview — See exactly how you’ll appear in search
  • Character Counters — With color-coded progress bars
  • Real-time Analysis — Instant feedback as you type

AI Search Optimization (NEW!)

Get discovered by AI search engines:

  • AI Bots Manager — Control which AI crawlers can access your site (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google Gemini, and more)
  • LLMs.txt Generator — Auto-generate llms.txt file for AI crawlers with site overview, pages, posts, and categories
  • LLMs-full.txt — Extended version with full content for AI indexing
  • Quick Presets — Allow All, Block Training, Block All, or Custom policy
  • AI Visibility Score — Real-time score showing how AI-ready your site is
  • Robots.txt Integration — AI bot rules automatically added to robots.txt

Redirect Manager

Professional redirect management:

  • 301 (Permanent), 302 (Temporary), 307 redirects
  • 410 (Gone) and 451 (Legal Block) status codes
  • Regex Support — Pattern matching with capture groups ($1, $2)
  • Query string preservation (UTM params, ref, etc.)
  • Hit counter for each redirect
  • Bulk actions (activate, deactivate, delete)
  • Import/Export redirects
  • One-click redirect from 404 errors
  • Fallback Redirect — Automatically redirect all 404s to homepage or custom URL

404 Error Monitor

Never miss a broken link:

  • Automatic logging of all 404 errors
  • Referer and User Agent tracking
  • Hit counter per URL
  • One-click convert to redirect
  • Bulk delete options

Robots.txt Editor

Full control over search engine crawling:

  • Virtual robots.txt (no file conflicts)
  • 5 ready-made templates (Default, E-commerce, Blog, Strict, Allow All)
  • Live preview
  • Syntax highlighting
  • One-click reset

XML Sitemap

Automatic, Google-compliant sitemap:

  • Auto-generated at /sitemap.xml
  • Sitemap index with separate sitemaps for posts, pages, categories, authors
  • Image Sitemap — Includes images from posts for Google Image Search
  • Author Sitemap — Help search engines discover author pages
  • Custom Post Types and Taxonomies support
  • Respects noindex settings
  • Beautiful XSL styling
  • Instant regeneration on content changes

Schema Markup (JSON-LD)

Structured data for rich snippets:

Knowledge Graph (Site-wide):
* WebSite schema with SearchAction (sitelinks searchbox)
* Organization or Person schema
* Social profiles (Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube, etc.)

Post/Page Schemas:
* Article / BlogPosting / NewsArticle
* WebPage schema
* FAQ schema (auto-detect from content)
* HowTo schema (auto-detect from step lists)
* Recipe schema
* Event schema
* Product schema (WooCommerce ready)
* LocalBusiness with 40+ subtypes (Restaurant, Hotel, etc.)

Image SEO

Automatic image optimization:

  • Auto-generate ALT text from filename
  • Auto-generate TITLE attributes
  • Improves accessibility and SEO

External Links Manager

Control outbound links:

  • Auto-add rel=”nofollow noopener”
  • Auto-add target=”_blank”
  • Configurable per-site settings

Breadcrumbs

SEO-friendly navigation:

  • Shortcode: [prime_seo_breadcrumbs]
  • PHP function: prime_seo_breadcrumbs()
  • Schema.org BreadcrumbList markup
  • Customizable styling

Instant Indexing (IndexNow)

Get your content indexed faster:

  • Submit URLs to search engines instantly
  • Supports Bing, Yandex, and other IndexNow partners
  • Auto-submit on publish/update (optional)
  • Bulk submit from posts list
  • Submission log with status tracking

Note: This feature sends URLs to the IndexNow API (api.indexnow.org) to request faster indexing by search engines.

Import & Export

Full backup and migration support:

  • Export all settings to JSON
  • Import from JSON file
  • Automatic backups (keeps last 5)
  • Auto-backup before import
  • Restore any backup with one click

SEO Score Column

Quick overview in posts list:

  • Visual score indicator
  • Color-coded (red/yellow/green)
  • Quick edit for Title & Description
  • Sortable column

Modern Design

  • Clean, intuitive interface
  • Consistent design across all pages
  • Mobile responsive
  • Dark sidebar support
  • Smooth animations

Why Choose Prime SEO?

All-in-One Solution
Everything you need for SEO in one plugin. No need for separate redirect, sitemap, or schema plugins.

Lightweight & Fast
Optimized code that won’t slow down your site. Assets load only where needed.

Easy to Use
Intuitive interface designed for beginners and professionals alike. Get started in minutes.

Developer Friendly
Clean code following WordPress standards. Hooks and filters for customization.

Regular Updates
Actively maintained and updated for latest WordPress versions and SEO best practices.

Privacy Policy

Prime SEO stores all data locally in your WordPress database:

  • SEO settings and meta data
  • Redirect rules
  • 404 error logs (IP addresses stored for debugging purposes only)
  • Backup files

External Services

The Instant Indexing feature (optional, disabled by default) communicates with the IndexNow API:

  • Service: IndexNow (api.indexnow.org)
  • Data sent: Your site’s URLs when you request indexing
  • Purpose: Request faster indexing by search engines (Bing, Yandex, and partners)
  • Privacy: IndexNow Privacy Policy

No other external API calls are made. No tracking or analytics are performed.

Support

For support, please use the WordPress.org support forum. We aim to respond within 24-48 hours.

Credits

Prime SEO is developed by the Prime SEO team.

Built following WordPress Coding Standards.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Prime SEO”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  5. Follow the Setup Wizard to configure your site

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the zip file and click “Install Now”
  4. Click “Activate Plugin”
  5. Follow the Setup Wizard

After Activation

The Setup Wizard will guide you through:
1. Setting up your homepage SEO
2. Enabling features (Sitemap, Image SEO, etc.)
3. Configuring robots.txt
4. You’re ready to optimize!
sections.faq:
Do I need SEO knowledge to use this plugin?

No! Prime SEO is designed for beginners. The Setup Wizard configures everything, and the metabox provides clear guidance with real-time feedback.

Will this slow down my website?

No. Prime SEO is optimized for performance. Assets load only where needed, and the code follows WordPress best practices.

Can I import from Yoast or Rank Math?

Yes! Prime SEO includes a powerful migration tool. Go to Prime SEO → Migration and select the plugin you want to import from. We support:

  • Yoast SEO (Free & Premium)
  • Rank Math (including redirects)
  • All in One SEO Pack
  • SEOPress

All your titles, descriptions, focus keywords, canonical URLs, and robot settings will be transferred automatically.

Where is my sitemap?

Your sitemap is automatically available at: yoursite.com/sitemap.xml

How do I add breadcrumbs to my theme?

Use the shortcode [prime_seo_breadcrumbs] in any post/page, or add <?php prime_seo_breadcrumbs(); ?> to your theme template.

Can I use this with other SEO plugins?

We don’t recommend it. Running multiple SEO plugins can cause conflicts and duplicate meta tags. Prime SEO includes everything you need.

How do redirects work?

Go to Prime SEO → Redirects, enter the old URL and new URL, select redirect type (301/302/307/410/451), and save. The redirect is instant.

What’s the difference between redirect types?

  • 301 — Permanent redirect (passes SEO value)
  • 302 — Temporary redirect (for temporary moves)
  • 307 — Temporary redirect (preserves request method)
  • 410 — Gone (page permanently deleted, faster removal from Google index)
  • 451 — Unavailable for legal reasons (DMCA, GDPR takedowns)

How do I fix 404 errors?

Go to Prime SEO → Redirects → 404 Log tab. You’ll see all 404 errors with options to create redirects or delete entries.

Is the robots.txt virtual or physical?

Virtual. Prime SEO doesn’t create a physical file, so there are no conflicts with existing files. It intercepts the request and serves the content dynamically.

What is LLMs.txt and why do I need it?

LLMs.txt is a new standard (like robots.txt) that helps AI search engines understand your site. It provides a structured overview of your content that AI crawlers like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity can use to better index and reference your site in AI-powered search results.

How do I control which AI bots can access my site?

Go to Prime SEO → AI Settings. You’ll find the AI Bots Manager where you can allow or block specific AI crawlers. Use Quick Presets for common configurations, or customize access for each bot individually.

Where are llms.txt and llms-full.txt?

They’re automatically available at:
* yoursite.com/llms.txt — Basic site overview
* yoursite.com/llms-full.txt — Extended version with full content (when enabled)
